name: Pricefy
summary: Competitor price monitoring and dynamic repricing for e-commerce, with AI product matching, price-intelligence dashboards, feed channels and autopilot repricing.
best_for: e-commerce sellers monitoring competitor prices and repricing catalogs up to ~25,000 SKUs on rules or autopilot
skip_if: you need intraday or real-time repricing at marketplace speed, or your catalog is small enough that the 50-SKU free tier is all you will ever use
honest_knock: Credit where due: the free tier is real. But the paid ladder rises fast — Starter at $49 buys only 100 SKUs, and repricing itself waits for Pro at $99 — and price updates run at most twice a day even on Enterprise, so this is rules-based repricing, not marketplace-speed. The headline prices are monthly rates; the advertised savings require annual commitment.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17, 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-16) A genuinely free tier: $0 for up to 50 SKUs, 5 competitors, daily price updates and AI automatch. Paid, with yearly billing saving 25%: Starter $49/mo ($37 annually), Pro $99/mo ($74), Business $189/mo ($142) and Enterprise $499/mo ($374). Starter covers 100 SKUs, Pro 2,000, Business 15,000 and Enterprise 25,000. Every paid plan adds unlimited competitors, twice-daily updates, email alerts and Excel/CSV reports; dynamic repricing starts on Pro, and autopilot repricing with MAP/MSRP monitoring on Business. Every plan, free included, carries AI product matching, competitor monitoring and daily price updates — what you buy going up is SKU volume and automation, not the core.

price_history.method: Stable = every amount on the vendor's pricing page identical across >= 3 of our reads over >= 30 days. A change is listed only after we confirmed the new price on the page, with a verbatim quote. Differences in raw readings are never published on their own.

free_plan_evidence: (re-verified 2026-08-17, 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-16) A genuinely free tier: $0 for up to 50 SKUs, 5 competitors, daily price updates and AI automatch.

compare_with.name: Prisync
compare_with.why: Prisync is the category veteran with similar per-SKU tiers; Pricefy undercuts on entry price and ships a real free tier — both cap update frequency, so speed-critical repricers need marketplace-native tools

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Pricefy on the Free plan of an account we created. Adding one product and one competitor page took about a minute and no card was asked, but the competitor price did not come in: after 4 minutes the page still said Missing Price, with a note that it would be read before 9:07 pm. On the Free plan prices are read once a day, so the first comparison comes hours later, not in minutes. The six alert rules and four reports were all switched off. The plan table in the app matches the public page, and yearly Starter opened a Stripe checkout in euros at EUR 417.43, which was left with nothing filled in. Account and start: we created the account and confirmed the e-mail address; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026 from 10:06 CET. The interface was in English, with United States and US Dollar as country and currency. The dashboard was empty. A setup wizard (Step 1 of 6) and a Competitors Discovery offer came back at every full page load and were closed each time; Discovery was not started. The plan was Free, Active, Forever Free, with 1 / 50 products after the test. The dossier name is Pricefy and the review is on AIBM (b2b/pricefy-review). Core action, track one competitor price for one product: My Catalog, Add Product, Quick Add Product needs a product name, SKU and price. The product LEGO Classic Medium Creative Brick Box 10696, SKU TEST-001, price 34.99, gave Product Added Successfully a little over a minute after the start. Add New Competitor URL takes one competitor URL per product; a public target.com product page was added and Competitor URLs added successfully appeared at 10:07:28. Clicking the small plus next to the field leaves Save disabled; without it Save works. First price: Monitored URLs showed Missing Price and Missing Stock after 10:07 and still at 10:11. The tooltip said This price will be scraped before next 9:07 pm, and Fetch Updated Price was disabled. So no competitor price came in within 4 minutes; the first price comes with the daily scrape of the Free plan. Whether target.com later returned a price was not checked. Alerts and reports: Alert History said No alerts yet; Alert Rules held six default rules, all off, Last Email Sent Never. Reports held four weekly reports, all off, Last Run Never. The public page lists Price Change Notification and Excel/eMail Reports from Starter. Nothing was sent, no store was linked and Discovery was not run. Plans: In the app (Billing, Change Plan) and on pricefy.io/pricing, in USD, per month: Free $0, Starter $49, Pro $99 (Popular), Business $189 and Enterprise $499. Products 50, 100, 2,000, 15,000 and 25,000; competitors 5 on Free and unlimited on paid plans; monitored URLs 45, 500, 3,000, 15,000 and 85,000; channels 1, 3 and unlimited; price updates Daily (1) on Free and Daily (2) on paid plans. Yearly (Save up to 25%): Starter $441, Pro $891 (about $74 a month), Business $1700 and Enterprise $400 a month ($4800 a year). The public page lists Price Change Notification and Excel/eMail Reports from Starter and Dynamic Repricing from Pro, and says Free forever plan, No credit card required, Live in 2 minutes and Cancel anytime. The Monitored URLs add-on needs a paid plan; the AI Assistant add-on is for Professional, Business and Enterprise, with 50 free messages a month. Checkout: Select Plan on Starter with yearly billing opened a live Stripe checkout at once, in Dutch because of the browser language: a Starter subscription at EUR 417.43 a year, billed yearly, total due today EUR 417.43, with no trial on the page. Nothing was filled in and the page was left; no image was kept because the page was not in English. Cancelling: on the Free plan there is nothing to cancel. My Account, My Profile has a link to delete the account (GDPR compliant), which was not clicked. Cancelling a paid plan through Billing was not tested. Not tested: the first real competitor price and the comparison, a CSV import of 10 products (1 product was added by hand), Competitor Discovery, repricing, Buy Box cases and cancelling a paid plan. Clean up: the account and the test product with one target.com URL stay. The own tab and a help tab the app opened were closed; our tab was not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: On the Free plan the first competitor price comes with the next daily scrape, hours later, and Fetch Updated Price is disabled. The setup wizard and the Discovery offer return at every full page load. Clicking the plus next to the competitor URL field leaves Save disabled. The yearly checkout charged in euros while the plan table shows dollars.
